new_fields_per_window_per_seed.per_m: array, one entry per m-residue (m=18t, t=0..F1_prime-1), value = JSON null if gcd(2m+1,K_ord)!=1 (never evaluated), else an INTEGER >=0 (count of witnessing coset elements at that m). Strict null/0 distinction enforced by both producer and checker.
new_fields_per_window_per_seed.lift_m: count of gcd-eligible m with per_m[m]>=1
new_fields_per_window_per_seed.mult_set: SORTED list of DISTINCT nonzero per_m values (MULT-COSET theorem: size<=1, i.e. multiplicity is constant across every lifting m -- a size>1 set is a THEOREM VIOLATION)
new_fields_per_window_per_seed.valid_total: sum of all per_m entries (same quantity the old top-level valid_count already reported, kept for backward compat)
new_fields_per_window_per_seed.verdict: exclusive priority lattice: BUG if lift_m>F1_double_prime or |mult_set|>1; else DROP if valid_total=0; else ANOMALY if lift_m<F1_double_prime; else PASS

second_real_finding_this_pass_a_genuine_.diagnosis: NOT a producer bug. This window has c_in_K=False (K_ord=36, degree=420). The checker's homomorphism-tracked chain for tau~ was built ONLY over G=<JX,JY> (per its own documented scope-limitation comment: 'JC only enters as a fixed multiplicative constant... sufficient for every row tested so far'). Direct diagnostic (scratchpad/item_anomaly_crosscheck_v1.g-style standalone check) confirmed: tau~(y^m f) genuinely LEAVES G when c_in_K is False (since tau~(y)=y^-1 x^-1 c involves JC, which is outside G exactly when c_in_K is False), so tau~^2's second application could not be sifted through a G-only chain -- a real, previously-untriggered CHECKER coverage gap (every c_in_K=False window tested before this pass's own 20-window dry run happened to have F2_ratio small enough, or simply hadn't reached a charming witness at the hex311 stage, to expose this).
second_real_finding_this_pass_a_genuine_.fix: search/drophunt_checker_v3.py: generalized build_hom_tracked_chain into build_hom_tracked_chain_general(gen_image_pairs, deg), accepting an ARBITRARY list of (generator,image) pairs rather than a hardcoded 2-generator (JX,JY) form. tau_chain is now built as build_hom_tracked_chain_general([(JX,JY),(JY,tau_img_y),(JC,JC)], deg) -- covering the FULL A=<JX,JY,JC> (theta_chain is unchanged/still 2-generator, since theta~(x)=y and theta~(y)=x never leave G regardless of c_in_K). When c_in_K is True, JC=identity and the generalized chain naturally degenerates back to the old 2-generator behavior (identity is filtered out of the working generator set), so this is backward-compatible, not a behavior change for any c_in_K=True receipt.
second_real_finding_this_pass_a_genuine_.verification: both previously-failing receipts re-checked PASS after the fix (individually, then again as part of the full 83-receipt batch below). The producer's own hex311=True verdict for this row was correct throughout -- confirmed by GAP's own GroupHomomorphismByImages evaluation over the full A, which was never scope-limited in the first place.
